title: Best-of-N attempts
refreshFailed: Could not refresh this run. The last synced summary remains visible.
empty: No best-of-N runs in this conversation.
head: Recorded head
dirtyExcluded: Uncommitted checkout changes were not carried into these attempts.
pairedReadOnly: This device shows a synced summary. It can ask the executing Host to stop the run; choosing, checking and publishing a winner happen only on that Host.
actionFailed: The action failed. Refresh and review the recorded state before retrying.
candidateFailed: The candidate failed. Inspect its session for details.
noChanges: No code changes; this candidate cannot be published.
diffFailed: Could not load this revision diff.
confirmPublish: Publish only the selected head {sha} to {branch}. Nothing will be pushed.
archiveFailed: Publication status is unchanged. Some workspaces or sessions could not be archived; retry cleanup.
stopRequested: Stop requested. The executing Host stops each attempt and syncs the result.
